A '''zombified piglin''' in [[Matcha Flavoured]] drops {{ItemLink|Tattered Leather}} instead of rotten flesh, and only drops anything when killed by a player.

== Drops ==
{{Data/Loot/minecraft/entities/zombified_piglin}}
All drops require a player kill.<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/minecraft/loot_table/entities/zombified_piglin.json}}</ref> Tattered leather (0–1) replaces rotten flesh; the gold nuggets (0–1) and the rare gold ingot are as in vanilla. Zombified piglins don't drop {{ItemLink|Raw Estus}}.

== Behavior ==
Zombified piglins are undead, so [[warding]] hurts them. They are not one of the pack's "mundane hostile" mobs, so their spawning and attributes are not changed.
